source.citation: Apollo 11 AS-506 Post Launch Trajectory, NASA CR-61291, Table 2.2
source.transcription_method: OCR of pinned NASA report followed by visual verification of all six state components for each retained epoch on PDF page 35; event/scalar fields retain the source table pages listed per row.

scope.interpretation: Sparse source-closed early S-II states; not a continuous trajectory, flight truth, or ascent validation.

validation.closure_definition: Compare Euclidean norms of the six visually verified space-fixed state components to the source's scalar geocentric radius and inertial speed.

limitations: The trajectory is NASA real-time operational guidance-reference data, not raw telemetry or independent flight truth.
Only five early S-II state checkpoints are included. The remaining S-II and S-IVB rows are not source-closed and are excluded.
The S-II center-engine-cutoff time discrepancy between NASA CR-61291 Tables 2.1 and 2.4 remains unresolved.
The same-epoch 161.59 s pre-reset S-IC state remains in apollo11_sic_reference.csv; this record is the post-reset S-II state.
